title: Bag of Bricks -Shiny Blue 05
descriptionHtml:
Shiny Blue — colour 05

A vivid, saturated blue with real punch. Use it for open sky, swimming pools and graphic designs that need one colour to dominate. It holds its intensity even in small areas.

Works well with: Aqua Blue 07, Deep Blue 13, White 37

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Shiny Blue bricks (colour 05) for Memobrick mosaics. A vivid, saturated blue for skies, water and bold graphic designs. Precision-moulded fit.
